answer: A Dedicated device bound by attestation certificate with annual re-verification turns a private channel into public evidence: the dedicated device answers a fresh challenge, the attestation certificate is recorded, and annual re-verification keeps one channel from spawning many identities, so anyone can check that the identity is backed by a real, reachable channel. The system trusts a summit only after its channel answers the challenge. From the violet to the yarrow, the same rule holds: no channel, no trust, no exception.
